full_text_zh:
[P1] 中国
经典神话故事
绘本
女娲造人
哈皮童年 编绘
海峡出版发行集团 福建科学技术出版社

[P2] 盘古开辟了天地，用身躯造出日月星辰、山川草木，而他最后吐出的一口灵气则留在世间。

[P3] 灵气孕育出一位女神——女娲。女娲有着人身蛇尾，容貌娇美。闲时，女娲就在天地间游荡。尽管满山都是飞虫鸟兽，但她始终觉得很孤单。

[P4] 女娲走到河边，看到鱼儿在水中嬉戏，于是向它们述说心中的苦闷。可是鱼儿无法听懂她的言语，于是她就想：要是还有像自己这样能说话、玩耍的人，该有多好啊！

[P5] 女娲沿着河边滑行，低头看见了水面上自己美丽的影子，顿时高兴起来。
她决定用河床里的软泥按照自己的形和貌来捏泥人

[P6] 女娲心灵手巧，很快就捏好了许多泥人。她俯下身来一看，发现所有的泥人都倒在地上立不起来。这是怎么回事呢？原来是泥土捏的蛇尾让他们无法站立。

[P7] 女娲低头思考一番，决定按照自己双手
的样子，把泥人的蛇尾改成双脚。

终于，泥人都站了起来。他们
的长相与女娲相似，只是双脚代替
了蛇尾。

[P8] 看着这些泥人，女娲很高兴。她吹了一口仙气，泥人都动了起来。他们蹦蹦跳跳，能言善语，女娲称呼他们为“人”。

[P9] 人感谢了女娲赐予他们生命之后，就蹦蹦跳跳地离开了。可是没过多久，他们又跑了回来，垂头丧气地问女娲：“我们该去哪里呢？”

[P10] 女娲大笑起来，说道：“你们不要害怕。你们现在要做的就是建立自己的住所，也就是‘家’。”
女娲带着人走到一片空地旁边，让他们寻找木头搭起草屋来，然后找了很多干草铺在地面，让他们睡在上面。

[P11] 人学得很快，他们不仅学会了搭草屋，还学会了寻找山洞，清出碎石，让自己住在里面。
女娲还教会在太阳升起后去寻找食物，在太阳下山后回家休息。

[P12] 一天，女娲走到一处，见到人
全都倒在地上一动不动，很
是奇怪。仔细观察后，她
发现这些人是最初创造出来
的那一批，现在他们都
已经头发雪白，死去了。

[P13] 女娲非常难过，心想：这些人是我辛苦创造出来的，
如今却不断衰老死亡，我该怎么办呢？

这时，她发现兔子可以繁衍后代，顿时灵光一闪：对啊！为什么我
就不能让人也像动物这样自己繁衍后代呢？

[P14] 于是女娲重新捏出两个泥人，朝右手的那个泥人注入阳刚之气，朝左手的那个泥人注入阴柔之气，然后将两个人放在草屋里面。

[P15] 过了一段时间，女娲再次寻来，发现这两个人住的草屋旁边多了好多草屋，里面住着男女老少。
女娲大喜，看来这次终于成功了！她想要创造出更多的男女，于是又开始动手捏起泥人来。时间长了，女娲累得捏不动了，心想：这样捏太慢了。

[P16] 这时，一股清风吹动女娲的长发。女娲一喜，将长发剪下一截，放在泥里，然后用力一甩，顿时有许多许多的泥人降落下来。就这样，女娲创造出遍布大地的人。

[P17] 从此，人类慢慢繁衍下来，直至今日。人类为了感谢女娲赐予生命，建起圣母女娲神庙进行供奉参拜。
full_text_en:
[P1] China
Classic Mythological Stories
Picture Book
Nüwa Creates Humans
Compiled and Illustrated by Happy Childhood
Strait Publishing and Distribution Group, Fujian Science and Technology Press

[P2] Pangu opened up the heavens and the earth, and with his body created the sun, moon, stars, mountains, rivers, grass, and trees. The last breath of spiritual energy he exhaled remained in the world.

[P3] The vital energy gave birth to a goddess—Nüwa. Nüwa had a human body and a snake tail, and was beautiful in appearance. In her leisure time, Nüwa wandered through the heavens and earth. Although the mountains were full of flying insects, birds, and beasts, she always felt very lonely.

[P4] Nüwa walked to the riverside, saw the fish playing in the water, and then told them about her inner troubles. But the fish couldn't understand her words, so she thought: If only there were someone else like me who could talk and play, how wonderful that would be!

[P5] Nüwa glided along the riverbank, looked down, and saw her beautiful reflection on the water's surface. She was instantly delighted.
She decided to use the soft mud from the riverbed to mold figures in her own shape and form.

[P6] Nüwa was skillful and quickly molded many clay figures. She bent down to look and found that all the clay figures were lying on the ground, unable to stand up. What was going on? It turned out that the snake tails made of clay prevented them from standing.

[P7] Nüwa thought for a moment, then decided to shape the clay figures according to the form of her own hands, changing their snake tails into two feet.

Finally, the clay figures stood up. They resembled Nüwa, except that they had two feet instead of snake tails.

[P8] Looking at these clay figures, Nüwa was very happy. She blew a breath of divine air, and the clay figures came to life. They jumped and danced, could speak and communicate, and Nüwa called them 'humans'.

[P9] After thanking Nüwa for giving them life, the people skipped away happily. But not long after, they ran back, looking dejected, and asked Nüwa, “Where should we go?”

[P10] Nüwa laughed and said, "Don't be afraid. What you need to do now is to build your own dwelling—that is, 'home.'"
Nüwa led the people to an empty plot of land, told them to find wood and build grass huts, then gathered a lot of dry grass to lay on the ground for them to sleep on.

[P11] People learned quickly. They not only learned to build grass huts, but also learned to find caves, clear out rocks, and live inside them.
Nüwa also taught them to look for food after the sun rose, and to return home to rest after the sun set.

[P12] One day, Nuwa walked to a place and saw people
all lying on the ground, motionless, which was
very strange. After careful observation, she
realized these were the first batch she had created,
and now they had all turned white-haired and had died.

[P13] Nüwa was very sad, thinking: These people were created by me with great effort,
but now they are constantly aging and dying. What should I do?

At this moment, she noticed that rabbits could reproduce offspring, and suddenly had an idea: Oh! Why can't I
let humans reproduce offspring just like animals?

[P14] So Nüwa molded two new clay figures again, infused the one in her right hand with yang energy, the one in her left hand with yin energy, and then placed the two people inside the thatched hut.

[P15] After some time, Nuwa came to look again and found that many more huts had been built beside the two people's hut, and they were inhabited by men, women, the old, and the young.
Nuwa was overjoyed. It seemed this time she had finally succeeded! She wanted to create even more men and women, so she began to mold clay figures again. After a long time, Nuwa grew tired and could no longer mold them, thinking: This is too slow.

[P16] At this moment, a gentle breeze stirred Nüwa's long hair. Delighted, Nüwa cut off a strand, placed it in the clay, and then gave it a strong flick. Instantly, many, many clay figures fell down. In this way, Nüwa created people who spread across the earth.

[P17] From then on, humans gradually multiplied, until today. To thank Nuwa for giving them life, humans built temples dedicated to the Holy Mother Nuwa for worship and veneration.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《女娲造人》的封面，展示了女娲捏造人类的插画，并标明了书名、编绘者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页描绘了盘古开天辟地后，用身躯化为万物，并将最后一口灵气留在世间的场景，为后续女娲造人埋下伏笔。
[P3] 本页描绘了女娲诞生后在天地间游荡的场景，她虽有飞虫鸟兽相伴，却感到孤单，为后续造人埋下伏笔。
[P4] 女娲在河边看到鱼儿嬉戏，向它们倾诉孤独，但鱼儿无法理解，她因此更加渴望能有会说话、会玩耍的同类。
[P5] 女娲在河边看到自己美丽的倒影，感到高兴，并决定用河床的软泥按照自己的模样捏造人类。
[P6] 女娲捏好泥人后发现他们因蛇尾而无法站立，感到困惑。
[P7] 女娲思考后决定将泥人的蛇尾改为双脚，最终泥人成功站立，外形与女娲相似，仅以双脚代替蛇尾。
[P8] 女娲吹仙气使泥人活了过来，他们能动、能说话，女娲因此称他们为“人”。
[P9] 人类在获得生命后短暂离开，不久又因迷茫而返回，向女娲询问去向。
[P10] 女娲教导新造的人类建立住所，称之为‘家’，并带领他们用木头搭建草屋，铺上干草以便安睡。
[P11] 本页描绘了女娲教导新造的人类搭建住所、寻找山洞居住，并教会他们在日出时觅食、日落时归家休息的生活技能。
[P12] 女娲发现最初创造的人类已白发苍苍、倒地死去，感到震惊和悲伤。
[P13] 女娲目睹自己创造的人类衰老死亡，感到悲伤并思考解决办法；她观察到兔子能繁衍后代，灵光一闪，想到让人类也能自行繁衍。
[P14] 女娲重新捏出两个泥人，分别注入阳刚与阴柔之气，并将他们安置在草屋中，为人类繁衍做准备。
[P15] 女娲发现最初创造的两个人已繁衍出众多后代，居住在新建的草屋中，她为此感到欣喜，但因手工捏人太慢而感到疲惫。
[P16] 女娲受到清风启发，剪下长发混入泥土并甩出，瞬间创造出大量泥人，遍布大地，完成了人类的批量创造。
[P17] 本页描绘了人类繁衍至今，并为感谢女娲赐予生命而建庙供奉的场景，画面中两人跪拜于女娲神像前。
